products.name: Premium Jasmine Rice 5kg
products.description: Experience the finest quality with our Premium Jasmine Rice. Carefully harvested to ensure long, slender grains that cook up incredibly fluffy and aromatic. Perfect for complementing rich stews, savory curries, or simply enjoyed on its own. Packaged securely to lock in freshness.
